```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- arrow::read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- arrow::read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- arrow::read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")
crypto <- prices |>
  dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    categories |> dplyr::select(category_id, category_name),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  dplyr::group_by(date, category_name) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    category_market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::complete(
    date,
    category_name,
    fill = list(category_market_cap_usd = 0)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    category_name = forcats::fct_reorder(
      category_name,
      category_market_cap_usd,
      .fun = mean,
      .desc = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(x = date, y = category_market_cap_usd, fill = category_name)
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_area(position = "fill") +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-05-07"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-05-12"),
    ymin = 0,
    ymax = 1,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2022-05-09"),
    y = 0.98,
    label = "Luna/UST crash\nMay 7-12, 2022",
    size = 2.8,
    vjust = 1,
    label.size = 0.15
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-11-08"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-11-11"),
    ymin = 0,
    ymax = 1,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2022-11-09"),
    y = 0.82,
    label = "FTX collapse\nNov 8-11, 2022",
    size = 2.8,
    vjust = 1,
    label.size = 0.15
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Cryptocurrency Market-Cap Share by Category",
    subtitle = "Daily market-cap share by category; bands sum to 100% on each date.",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of total market capitalization",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: daily_prices.parquet, coin_metadata.parquet, and categories.parquet."
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  dplyr::select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date) |>
  dplyr::arrange(coin_id) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
metadata <- metadata |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    launch_date_parsed = as.Date(
      lubridate::parse_date_time(launch_date, orders = c("ymd", "B d, Y"))
    )
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(metadata$launch_date_parsed))

metadata |>
  dplyr::select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed) |>
  dplyr::arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |> arrow::schema()
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  dplyr::slice_sample(n = 10) |>
  tibble::as_tibble()
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  dplyr::filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  dplyr::group_by(coin_id) |>
  dplyr::summarize(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  dplyr::collect() |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  dplyr::filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = as.Date(date_raw), y = price_usd)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Daily Price",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```
